title: Reset your password
text: To reset your password, open the sign-in page, select Forgot password, and follow the instructions sent to your registered email address.

title: Refund eligibility
text: Refund requests are accepted within 30 days of purchase. Include your order number when contacting support. Requests outside this period require review by a support representative.

title: Track an order
text: To track an order, open Orders in your account and select the order you want to view. The tracking page displays the latest available shipping status.
